{"id":1516106787,"question_id":6,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"1 year, 6 months","timestamp":1737485823,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"3 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1516106787/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Zigzag Conversion","memory":"14.1 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    string convert(string s, int numRows) {\n        int row =0 , i=0;\n        bool direction = 1;\n        vector<string>ans(numRows);\n\n        if(numRows == 1) return s;\n\n        while(i<s.size())\n        {\n            if(direction == 1)\n            {\n                while(i<s.size() && row<numRows)\n                {\n                    ans[row].push_back(s[i]);\n                    row++;\n                    i++;\n                }\n                row -= 2;\n            }\n            else\n            {\n                while(i<s.size() && row>=0)\n                {\n                    ans[row].push_back(s[i]);\n                    row--;\n                    i++;\n                }\n                row = 1;\n            }\n            direction = !direction ;\n        }\n        string final = \"\";\n    for(auto str : ans )\n    {\n        final += str;\n    }\n    return final;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"zigzag-conversion","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":225}
